name: find-iterations
description: Identify top performers and fatiguing creatives, then suggest specific iterations — new hooks, format variations, audience pivots, and refreshes. Produces structured iteration cards ready for briefing. Activate when users ask to "find iterations", "what should we iterate on", "refresh ideas", "creative refresh", "what's fatiguing", "extend our winners", "what to test next", or need iteration opportunities from existing creative performance.
